ch: He got lost with a dying phone

qs.q: How long after asking did he arrive?

gram.d: 好像 = 'it seems / apparently': 好像走錯路了 — seems I took a wrong turn. Softens statements the way Taiwanese speech loves: 他好像感冒了.

qs.q: What do people do in the park each morning?

ch: Supermarket and convenience store next door

gram.d: 離 measures distance between two points: 我家離公司不遠 — my place isn't far from the office. Always 離, never 從, for how-far statements.

readings.title: 去超市買東西 Supermarket Run

qs.q: What couldn't he find at first?

gram.d: Verb + 不到 = can't manage to: 找不到 can't find, 買不到 can't get one, 看不到 can't see. The positive is V+得到.

qs.q: What do you need to rent a YouBike?

ch: Faster than walking, easier than driving

gram.d: [condition] 的話 = 'if…': 你來台灣的話 — if you come to Taiwan. Softer and more spoken than 如果; often they combine: 如果…的話.

readings.title: 請客戶吃飯 Treating the Client (stretch)

qs.q: What does 請客 mean here?
What business lesson does he draw?

gram.d: 請 someone + verb = treat/invite them to do it: 我請你吃飯 I'm buying you dinner; 我請你喝咖啡. 請客 = to be the one treating — sacred Taiwanese ritual; expect a friendly fight over the bill.

dict.py: Qǐngwèn chāoshì zěnme zǒu?
dict.en: How do I get to the supermarket?

dict.py: Yìzhí zǒu, zài gōngyuán pángbiān.
dict.en: Go straight — it's next to the park.

dict.py: Wǒ jiā lí gōngsī hěn jìn.
dict.en: My home is close to the office.

dict.py: Cèsuǒ zài hòumiàn, mén de pángbiān.
dict.en: The restroom is in the back, next to the door.

dict.py: Qiánmiàn lùkǒu yòu zhuǎn jiù dào le.
dict.en: Turn right at the intersection ahead and you're there.

pass.zh: 公園離這裡不遠，走路十分鐘就到。一直走，看到便利商店左轉，公園就在前面。

dict.py: Qǐngwèn niúnǎi zài nǎlǐ?
dict.en: Where is the milk?

dict.py: Zài zuì hòumiàn, miànbāo de pángbiān.
dict.en: At the very back, next to the bread.

dict.py: Jīntiān shuǐguǒ mǎi yī sòng yī.
dict.en: Fruit is buy-one-get-one today.

dict.py: Hái xūyào dàizi ma?
dict.en: Do you need a bag as well?

dict.py: Yígòng sānbǎi èrshí kuài.
dict.en: 320 in total.

pass.zh: 各位客人您好，今天晚上八點以後，麵包打五折，牛奶第二瓶半價，歡迎選購，謝謝！

dict.py: Nǐ xiànzài yào qù nǎlǐ?
dict.en: Where are you headed now?

dict.zh: 我先回家，等一下再出去。
dict.py: Wǒ xiān huí jiā, děng yíxià zài chūqù.
dict.en: I'll go home first and head out again later.

dict.zh: 外面在下雨，我們跑快一點！
dict.py: Wàimiàn zài xiàyǔ, wǒmen pǎo kuài yìdiǎn!
dict.en: It's raining — let's run faster!

dict.py: Chē tíng zài gōngsī hòumiàn.
dict.en: The car is parked behind the office.

dict.zh: 我騎車十五分鐘就到了。
dict.py: Wǒ qí chē shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
dict.en: It's just a 15-minute ride for me.

pass.zh: 喂，我是小美！我們晚上七點在捷運站見，二號出口喔！我會早一點到。你不要迷路了，哈哈！

dict.py: Wǒ zhǎo bú dào nà jiā cāntīng.
dict.en: I can't find that restaurant.

dict.py: Wǒ de shǒujī kuài méi diàn le.
dict.en: My phone is almost dead.

dict.py: Zhèlǐ de lù wǒ bù zhīdào.
dict.en: I don't know the roads here.

dict.py: Hǎoxiàng zǒu cuò lù le.
dict.en: Seems we took a wrong turn.

dict.py: Tài hǎo le, zhōngyú dào le!
dict.en: Finally — we made it!

pass.zh: 昨天我要去一家新的餐廳，可是我迷路了，手機也沒電，不能看地圖。我問了一個路人，他人很好，帶我走到餐廳門口。台灣人真的很熱情！

qs.q: What two problems did he have?

dict.zh: 今天的飛行測試非常成功。
dict.py: Jīntiān de fēixíng cèshì fēicháng chénggōng.
dict.en: Today's flight test was a great success.

dict.py: Kèhù kàn qǐlái hěn mǎnyì.
dict.en: The client looks very satisfied.

dict.zh: 晚上我們請王先生吃飯。
dict.py: Wǎnshàng wǒmen qǐng Wáng xiānshēng chīfàn.
dict.en: Tonight we're treating Mr. Wang to dinner.

dict.zh: 這家餐廳離公司不遠，走路就到。
dict.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng lí gōngsī bù yuǎn, zǒulù jiù dào.
dict.en: The restaurant isn't far from the office — walkable.

dict.zh: 大家辛苦了，明天可以晚一點上班。
dict.py: Dàjiā xīnkǔ le, míngtiān kěyǐ wǎn yìdiǎn shàngbān.
dict.en: Great work everyone — you can come in late tomorrow.

pass.zh: 跟大家報告好消息：今天的測試很成功，無人機飛了三十分鐘，客戶非常滿意。晚上六點半我們請客戶吃飯，餐廳在公司附近。今天大家都辛苦了！

qs.q: How long did the drone fly?

scenarios.intro: You're turned around looking for a restaurant called 好好味. Flag someone down, repeat the directions back — the skill that saves you every time.

them.zh: 你好，你看起來在找什麼，需要幫忙嗎？
them.py: Nǐ hǎo, nǐ kàn qǐlái zài zhǎo shénme, xūyào bāngmáng ma?
them.en: Hi — you look like you're searching for something. Need help?

turns.task: Say you're lost — you're looking for a restaurant called 好好味.

ans.zh: 我迷路了！我在找一家叫好好味的餐廳。
ans.py: Wǒ mílù le! Wǒ zài zhǎo yì jiā jiào Hǎohǎowèi de cāntīng.
ans.en: I'm lost! I'm looking for a restaurant called Haohaowei.

them.zh: 喔我知道！一直走，第二個路口左轉。
them.py: Ō wǒ zhīdào! Yìzhí zǒu, dì èr ge lùkǒu zuǒ zhuǎn.
them.en: Oh I know it! Straight ahead, left at the second intersection.

turns.task: Repeat it back to confirm: straight, second intersection, turn left — right?

ans.zh: 一直走，第二個路口左轉，對嗎？
ans.py: Yìzhí zǒu, dì èr ge lùkǒu zuǒ zhuǎn, duì ma?
ans.en: Straight, then left at the second intersection — right?

them.zh: 對！餐廳就在超市的旁邊。
them.py: Duì! Cāntīng jiù zài chāoshì de pángbiān.
them.en: Right! It's just next to the supermarket.

turns.task: Ask whether it's far.

ans.zh: 請問遠不遠？
ans.py: Qǐngwèn yuǎn bù yuǎn?
ans.en: Is it far?

them.zh: 不遠，走路大概五分鐘。
them.py: Bù yuǎn, zǒulù dàgài wǔ fēnzhōng.
them.en: Not far — about five minutes on foot.

turns.task: Great — thank them sincerely.

ans.zh: 太好了，真的很謝謝你！
ans.py: Tài hǎo le, zhēnde hěn xièxie nǐ!
ans.en: Perfect — thank you so much!

them.zh: 不會！祝你吃得開心！
them.py: Bú huì! Zhù nǐ chī de kāixīn!
them.en: No problem! Enjoy your meal!

turns.task: Tell them they're so kind, and say bye.

ans.zh: 你人真好！掰掰！
ans.py: Nǐ rén zhēn hǎo! Bāibāi!
ans.en: You're so kind! Bye!

scenarios.intro: Hunt down milk and bread, catch the discount, and find the checkout — all in Mandarin.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨，需要幫忙嗎？
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín, xūyào bāngmáng ma?
them.en: Welcome — can I help you?

turns.task: Ask where the milk is.

ans.zh: 請問牛奶在哪裡？
ans.py: Qǐngwèn niúnǎi zài nǎlǐ?
ans.en: Where's the milk, please?

them.zh: 牛奶在最後面，右邊。
them.py: Niúnǎi zài zuì hòumiàn, yòubiān.
them.en: Milk's at the very back, on the right.

turns.task: Thanks — and ask about the bread.

ans.zh: 謝謝。麵包呢？
ans.py: Xièxie. Miànbāo ne?
ans.en: Thanks. And the bread?

them.zh: 麵包在前面，門的旁邊，今天打八折喔！
them.py: Miànbāo zài qiánmiàn, mén de pángbiān, jīntiān dǎ bāzhé o!
them.en: Bread's up front by the door — 20% off today!

turns.task: Nice — say you'll buy some, and ask where to check out.

ans.zh: 太好了，我要買一些。請問在哪裡結帳？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le, wǒ yào mǎi yìxiē. Qǐngwèn zài nǎlǐ jiézhàng?
ans.en: Great, I'll grab some. Where do I check out?

them.zh: 前面有三個結帳的地方，走過去就看到了。
them.py: Qiánmiàn yǒu sān ge jiézhàng de dìfāng, zǒu guòqù jiù kàndào le.
them.en: Three registers up front — you'll see them.

turns.task: Got it — thank them for the help.

ans.zh: 好，我知道了，謝謝你的幫忙！
ans.py: Hǎo, wǒ zhīdào le, xièxie nǐ de bāngmáng!
ans.en: Got it — thanks for your help!

them.zh: 不會，慢慢逛喔！
them.py: Bú huì, mànmàn guàng o!
them.en: Of course — take your time browsing!

turns.task: Thanks, bye!

ans.zh: 謝謝，掰掰！
ans.py: Xièxie, bāibāi!
ans.en: Thanks, bye!

scenarios.intro: Role reversal: a visitor can't figure out YouBike, and YOU are the local expert now. Teach the rental in simple Mandarin.

them.zh: 不好意思，請問你會用 YouBike 嗎？
them.py: Bù hǎo yìsi, qǐngwèn nǐ huì yòng YouBike ma?
them.en: Excuse me — do you know how to use YouBike?

turns.task: Say you do! Ask if they need help.

ans.zh: 我會！你需要幫忙嗎？
ans.py: Wǒ huì! Nǐ xūyào bāngmáng ma?
ans.en: I do! Need a hand?

them.zh: 對啊，我第一次用，怎麼借車？
them.py: Duì a, wǒ dì yī cì yòng, zěnme jiè chē?
them.en: Yes — first time. How do I rent one?

turns.task: Explain: super simple — tap your EasyCard here, then you can ride the bike away.

ans.zh: 很簡單，用悠遊卡碰這裡，然後就可以把車騎走了。
ans.py: Hěn jiǎndān, yòng Yōuyóukǎ pèng zhèlǐ, ránhòu jiù kěyǐ bǎ chē qí zǒu le.
ans.en: Easy — tap your EasyCard here, then ride it away.

them.zh: 喔喔！那要多少錢？
them.py: Ō ō! Nà yào duōshǎo qián?
them.en: Oh! And how much is it?

turns.task: Say it's cheap — the first thirty minutes are about ten dollars.

ans.zh: 很便宜，前三十分鐘差不多十塊。
ans.py: Hěn piányí, qián sānshí fēnzhōng chàbùduō shí kuài.
ans.en: Cheap — around NT$10 for the first 30 minutes.

them.zh: 太好了！那還車呢？
them.py: Tài hǎo le! Nà huán chē ne?
them.en: Great! And returning it?

turns.task: Any station works — push the bike in until you hear the sound.

ans.zh: 每個站都可以還，把車推進去，聽到聲音就好了。
ans.py: Měi ge zhàn dōu kěyǐ huán, bǎ chē tuī jìnqù, tīngdào shēngyīn jiù hǎo le.
ans.en: Any station — push it in until you hear the click.

them.zh: 你人真好，謝謝！
them.py: Nǐ rén zhēn hǎo, xièxie!
them.en: You're so kind — thanks!

turns.task: No problem — tell them to ride safely!

ans.zh: 不會！騎車小心喔！
ans.py: Bú huì! Qí chē xiǎoxīn o!
ans.en: No problem! Ride safe!

scenarios.intro: Heading to the client dinner. Give the destination, survive the compliment, and direct the drop-off like a local.

them.zh: 你好，要去哪裡？
them.py: Nǐ hǎo, yào qù nǎlǐ?
them.en: Hi, where to?

turns.task: To the 好好味 restaurant on Zhongshan Road (中山路), please.

ans.zh: 你好，麻煩到中山路的好好味餐廳。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, máfán dào Zhōngshān lù de Hǎohǎowèi cāntīng.
ans.en: Hi — Haohaowei restaurant on Zhongshan Road, please.

them.zh: 好的。現在下班時間，可能會塞車喔。
them.py: Hǎo de. Xiànzài xiàbān shíjiān, kěnéng huì sāichē o.
them.en: Sure. It's rush hour though — might hit traffic.

turns.task: No rush — but ask roughly how many minutes.

ans.zh: 沒關係，我不趕時間。大概要幾分鐘？
ans.py: Méi guānxi, wǒ bù gǎn shíjiān. Dàgài yào jǐ fēnzhōng?
ans.en: No rush. Roughly how many minutes?

them.zh: 順的話十五分鐘。欸，你中文說得不錯欸！
them.py: Shùn dehuà shíwǔ fēnzhōng. Éi, nǐ Zhōngwén shuō de búcuò éi!
them.en: Fifteen if it flows. Hey — your Chinese is pretty good!

turns.task: Thank him — you study every day, and Taiwanese friends help a lot.

ans.zh: 謝謝！我每天學中文，台灣朋友也常常幫我。
ans.py: Xièxie! Wǒ měitiān xué Zhōngwén, Táiwān péngyǒu yě chángcháng bāng wǒ.
ans.en: Thanks! I study daily, and my Taiwanese friends help a lot.

them.zh: 到了到了，餐廳就在前面。
them.py: Dào le dào le, cāntīng jiù zài qiánmiàn.
them.en: Here we are — it's just ahead.

turns.task: Ask him to stop at the intersection ahead — that's fine.

ans.zh: 前面路口停就可以了，謝謝。
ans.py: Qiánmiàn lùkǒu tíng jiù kěyǐ le, xièxie.
ans.en: Stopping at the intersection ahead is fine, thanks.

them.zh: 好，兩百一。祝你吃飯愉快！
them.py: Hǎo, liǎngbǎi yī. Zhù nǐ chīfàn yúkuài!
them.en: 210, then. Enjoy your dinner!

turns.task: Hand over the cash and ask for a receipt.

ans.zh: 給你。收據麻煩給我，謝謝！
ans.py: Gěi nǐ. Shōujù máfán gěi wǒ, xièxie!
ans.en: Here you go — and a receipt please, thanks!

scenarios.who: 客戶王先生 Client Mr. Wang
scenarios.intro: The test succeeded — now the real Taiwanese business happens at the dinner table. Toast, order thoughtfully, and win the fight for the bill. 先做朋友，再做生意。

them.zh: Eric！今天的測試太成功了！
them.py: Eric! Jīntiān de cèshì tài chénggōng le!
them.en: Eric! Today's test was a huge success!

turns.task: Credit his support, and toast him: here's to you!

ans.zh: 都是因為您的支持！來，我敬您一杯！
ans.py: Dōu shì yīnwèi nín de zhīchí! Lái, wǒ jìng nín yì bēi!
ans.en: All thanks to your support! Come — a toast to you!

them.zh: 哈哈，客氣了！這家餐廳你常來嗎？
them.py: Hāhā, kèqì le! Zhè jiā cāntīng nǐ cháng lái ma?
them.en: Haha, too kind! Do you come here often?

turns.task: First time — a coworker recommended it; the food is supposedly famous.

ans.zh: 第一次來，同事推薦的，聽說菜很有名。
ans.py: Dì yī cì lái, tóngshì tuījiàn de, tīngshuō cài hěn yǒumíng.
ans.en: First time — a coworker's recommendation. The food's famous, they say.

them.zh: 那你來點菜吧！
them.py: Nà nǐ lái diǎn cài ba!
them.en: Then you do the ordering!

turns.task: Politely ask if there's anything he doesn't eat, then say you'll order a few famous dishes.

ans.zh: 好！請問您有什麼不吃的嗎？我來點幾個有名的菜。
ans.py: Hǎo! Qǐngwèn nín yǒu shénme bù chī de ma? Wǒ lái diǎn jǐ ge yǒumíng de cài.
ans.en: Sure! Anything you don't eat? I'll order a few of the famous dishes.

them.zh: 我都可以！啊，服務生，先來兩瓶啤酒！
them.py: Wǒ dōu kěyǐ! A, fúwùshēng, xiān lái liǎng píng píjiǔ!
them.en: I eat everything! Ah — waiter, two beers to start!

turns.task: (End of the meal) Call for the check and insist: tonight's on us!

ans.zh: 老闆，結帳！王先生，今天我們請客！
ans.py: Lǎobǎn, jiézhàng! Wáng xiānshēng, jīntiān wǒmen qǐngkè!
ans.en: Check please! Mr. Wang — tonight is on us!

them.zh: 唉唷，怎麼好意思！那下次我請！
them.py: Āiyō, zěnme hǎoyìsi! Nà xiàcì wǒ qǐng!
them.en: Oh come on, I couldn't! Next time it's on me, then!

turns.task: Seal it: it's a deal — next time he treats. Thank him for coming today.

ans.zh: 一言為定，下次您請！謝謝您今天來。
ans.py: Yì yán wéi dìng, xiàcì nín qǐng! Xièxie nín jīntiān lái.
ans.en: It's a deal — next time you treat! Thank you for coming today.

x: 早上很多人在公園運動。
Zǎoshang hěnduō rén zài gōngyuán yùndòng.
Lots of people exercise in the park in the morning.
I'm going to the supermarket for milk.
vocab.n: 全聯 Pxmart is the everywhere-chain; 超商 = convenience store, 超市 = supermarket.

x: You have to queue at this restaurant.
I've been to this place before.

vocab.n: 買東西 = to shop. Literally 'east-west' — the classic story every teacher tells.
跑步 pǎobù = to go running (exercise).
回家 go home, 回公司 back to the office, 回台灣 return to Taiwan.

x: The airport is far from downtown.
Chāoshì hěn jìn, zǒulù jiù dào.
Jiéyùn zhàn jiù zài gōngsī pángbiān.
The MRT station is right next to the office.
There's a coffee shop up ahead.
The restroom is at the back of the shop.

vocab.n: 路口 lùkǒu = intersection; 中山路 = Zhongshan Rd — every Taiwan city has one.
門口 ménkǒu = doorway/entrance, where everyone agrees to meet.

x: Wǒ de chē tíng zài wàimiàn.
很多台灣人騎機車上班。
Hěnduō Táiwān rén qí jīchē shàngbān.
Many Taiwanese ride scooters to work.
vocab.n: 騎 for bikes/scooters (you straddle it); 開 for cars; 搭 for what you board.
停車場 = parking lot; 紅線 red curb = never park there.

x: 沒有手機我一定會迷路。
Méiyǒu shǒujī wǒ yídìng huì mílù.
Without my phone I'd definitely get lost.

slang.e: make a run for it, let's gooo
x: Chāoshì miànbāo wǔ zhé? Chōng yìbō!
slang.n: Taiwan gaming slang gone mainstream — 衝 'charge' + 一波 'one wave'. For any spontaneous mission.

slang.e: to rally a group (for food, deals, trips)
x: 我要揪團去吃火鍋，加一？
Wǒ yào jiūtuán qù chī huǒguō, jiā yī?
I'm getting a hotpot group together — you in?
slang.n: Taiwan, from Hokkien 揪 'to pull/gather'. 加一 = '+1, count me in' — reply it in any group chat.

x: 都沒有人揪我，我是邊緣人嗎？
Dōu méiyǒu rén jiū wǒ, wǒ shì biānyuánrén ma?
Nobody invited me… am I THAT friend?
slang.n: Taiwan internet self-deprecation, literally 'edge person'. Pairs perfectly with 揪團 jokes.

x: Let's hit the night market together this weekend!
slang.n: Hokkien for 一起. You'll hear it in songs, ads, and every uncle's invitation.
Mainland internet-speak, now common in Taiwan chats. Casual hype for departures.

slang.e: to get 'grass-planted' — talked into wanting something
x: 我被小美種草了那家餐廳，一定要去！
Wǒ bèi Xiǎoměi zhòngcǎo le nà jiā cāntīng, yídìng yào qù!
Xiaomei got me hooked on that restaurant — I HAVE to go!
slang.n: Mainland shopping slang (a want 'grows like grass'); big on Taiwanese social media too. Opposite: 拔草 (scratch the itch / lose interest).
